notes: VAT 10% on physical bars/coins and jewellery. KRX market trades are VAT-free, but physical withdrawal is charged 10% VAT. Duty coded 0% effective: sources conflict (3% basic reported, most imports tariff-free), UNI-PASS line not opened, hence low. Dealer bar premium about 5% flat (Maeil), not by size, so barPremiumPct empty. Jewellery making % and used % not found on an opened dealer page.

sources.name: Corgano - VAT on Gold in South Korea (citing KRX/NTS)
sources.what: Read 2026-11-27: bars/coins and jewellery 10% VAT; KRX-held gold VAT-free, 10% on withdrawal; imports tariff-free

sources.name: Corgano - Tax on Selling Gold in South Korea (citing KRX, KB, Maeil Business)
sources.what: Read 2026-11-27: physical bar = 10% VAT plus about 5% dealer premium (Maeil), about 15% break-even; silver bars/coins 10% VAT

sources.name: Daylongs - KRX Gold Market guide
